propositions: Deterministic repair, schema extraction, and sentinel selection from parse_structured must be wrapped in a Pydantic TextOutput function that raises ModelRetry on retryable StructuredOutputError while preserving the original error in the cause chain.
Stop and refusal safety checks from check_response must be enforced in an after_model_request capability hook that receives the full ModelResponse before the output function processes the text.
Terminal failures (refusal, content-filter, max_tokens) detected by check_response must raise UnretryableOutputError and abort after one model call without triggering a Pydantic retry prompt.
The adapter must preserve byte-for-byte parser behavior and expose no new pure entry points beyond the existing structured.py authorities.
Pydantic's bounded output retry must drive validation recovery without introducing a new retry loop, provider selection, usage projection, or persistence logic in pai_output.py.
